clients.name: Claude Code
clients.note: Restart open Claude Code sessions to see the cutlass tools. Local scope: only sessions started in the project folder.

clients.name: Claude Desktop
clients.note: Quit and restart Claude Desktop to load the server.

clients.name: Cursor
clients.note: Cursor picks the server up in Settings > MCP.

clients.name: Windsurf
clients.note: Refresh the MCP servers in the Cascade panel.

clients.name: VS Code (Copilot agent mode)
clients.note: Start the server from the MCP: List Servers command, then use agent mode.

clients.name: Gemini CLI
clients.note: Restart the Gemini CLI; /mcp lists the server.

clients.name: Codex CLI
clients.note: Restart the Codex CLI to load the server.

clients.name: Continue
clients.note: MCP tools are available in Continue's agent mode.

clients.name: Zed
clients.note: Zed starts context servers from its settings; the Agent panel lists the tools.

clients.name: OpenAI-compatible harness
clients.text:
Cutlass for an OpenAI-compatible tool-calling harness (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM and others)
Base URL: {url}
Tool definitions (function calling): {url}v1/tools?format=openai
Call a tool: POST {url}v1/call with {"tool": "<name>", "args": { ... }} and the header Authorization: Bearer <token>
Workflow text for the system prompt: {url}v1/instructions
Token: {token}
Example: python build/examples/agent-openai-compatible.py --base-url <endpoint> --model <model> --task "<task>"

clients.name: Anthropic SDK harness
clients.text:
Cutlass for an Anthropic SDK tool-use loop
Base URL: {url}
Tool definitions (tools parameter): {url}v1/tools?format=anthropic
Call a tool: POST {url}v1/call with {"tool": "<name>", "args": { ... }} and the header Authorization: Bearer <token>
Workflow text for the system prompt: {url}v1/instructions
Token: {token}
Example: python build/examples/agent-anthropic.py --task "<task>"
